basic_details.job_title: JNTUH Lab Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University Hyderabad (JNTUH) invites applications from eligible Indian nationals for four (04) purely temporary Lab Assistant posts at the Bajaj Engineering Skills Training (BEST) Centre: two in Vertical-I (Advanced Manufacturing – Robotics & Automation) and two in Vertical-VI (E-Mobility). Applications go by email to [email protected] with the subject "Application for BEST Centre". The last date is 18 November 2026. The notice does not say whether this date is for receipt or dispatch.

post_wise_qualification.post_name: Lab Assistant – Vertical-I, Advanced Manufacturing (Robotics & Automation), for the Mechanical Engineering Department
Lab Assistant – Vertical-VI, E-Mobility, for the EEE Department

qualification.details: Essential qualification: ITI/Diploma or B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, Robotics or related disciplines. Experience: preferably 1–2 years in an Automation/Robotics laboratory or relevant industrial environment. Technical skills: knowledge of robotics, automation systems, equipment installation and maintenance, troubleshooting, basic PLC/robot programming, sensors, actuators, control systems and laboratory management. | Essential qualification: ITI/Diploma or B.E./B.Tech. in Electrical, Electrical and Electronics, Electronics and Communication, Automotive, Electric Vehicles, Mechatronics or related disciplines. Experience: preferably 1–2 years in EV laboratories, battery testing, power electronics or EV industries. Technical skills: knowledge of lithium-ion batteries, Battery Management Systems (BMS), battery testing, AC/DC chargers, BLDC/PMSM motors, motor controllers, inverters, EV testbeds, MATLAB/Simulink, testing instruments, data acquisition and electrical safety. Desirable: familiarity with CAN/CAN FD, LIN, UDS, OCPP, ISO 15118, embedded systems and C/C++/Python. | Only Indian nationals may apply. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

selection_process: The notice says candidates may be required to attend a written test and/or personal interview. Selection will be made as per the norms prescribed by JNTUH/UIIC. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email. The notice prints no test pattern
important_instructions: The positions are purely temporary and associated with the activities of the BEST Centre. Preference will be given to candidates with relevant practical experience in the respective fields. The experience of 1–2 years is stated as "preferably" for both posts.

content_sections.heading: About the BEST Centre
content_sections.text: The Bajaj Engineering Skills Training (BEST) Centre is established at JNTUH under the CSR initiative of Bajaj Auto Limited. The Lab Assistants will support laboratory maintenance, equipment handling and training activities at the Centre. The Lab Assistants for Vertical-I are for the Mechanical Engineering Department, and those for Vertical-VI are for the EEE Department.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Email address: [email protected] Subject line: "Application for BEST Centre" Attach a detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV), educational certificates, and experience and skill certificates if any (see Enclosures). Last date for submission of application: 18.11.2026. The notice prints no postal address and no separate application form. It asks only for the documents listed below.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: ITI/Diploma or B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, Robotics or related disciplines. Experience: preferably 1–2 years in an Automation/Robotics laboratory or relevant industrial environment. Technical skills: knowledge of robotics, automation systems, equipment installation and maintenance, troubleshooting, basic PLC/robot programming, sensors, actuators, control systems and laboratory management. Essential qualification: ITI/Diploma or B.E./B.Tech. in Electrical, Electrical and Electronics, Electronics and Communication, Automotive, Electric Vehicles, Mechatronics or related disciplines. Experience: preferably 1–2 years in EV laboratories, battery testing, power electronics or EV industries. Technical skills: knowledge of lithium-ion batteries, Battery Management Systems (BMS), battery testing, AC/DC chargers, BLDC/PMSM motors, motor controllers, inverters, EV testbeds, MATLAB/Simulink, testing instruments, data acquisition and electrical safety. Desirable: familiarity with CAN/CAN FD, LIN, UDS, OCPP, ISO 15118, embedded systems and C/C++/Python. Only Indian nationals may apply. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

faq.question: Q1. How many Lab Assistant vacancies are there in JNTUH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are four (04) Lab Assistant posts: two in Vertical-I (Advanced Manufacturing – Robotics & Automation) and two in Vertical-VI (E-Mobility).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of application is 18.11.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the JNTUH Lab Assistant posts?
faq.answer: Both posts need ITI/Diploma or B.E./B.Tech. in the disciplines listed for the vertical. Vertical-I lists Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, Robotics or related disciplines. Vertical-VI lists Electrical, Electrical and Electronics, Electronics and Communication, Automotive, Electric Vehicles, Mechatronics or related disciplines.

faq.question: Q4. Is experience compulsory?
faq.answer: The notice says "preferably" 1–2 years of relevant experience for both posts. Preference will be given to candidates with relevant practical experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a JNTUH BEST Centre Lab Assistant?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 25,000/- for both posts.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email your CV and certificates to [email protected] on or before 18.11.2026.

faq.question: Q7. What subject line should I use in the email?
faq.answer: Use the subject "Application for BEST Centre".

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The notice calls the positions purely temporary and associated with the activities of the BEST Centre.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Candidates may be required to attend a written test and/or personal interview. Selection will be made as per the norms prescribed by JNTUH/UIIC.

faq.question: Q10. When will shortlisted candidates be informed?
faq.answer: The notice says shortlisted candidates will be informed by email, giving the date 20.11.2026.
